**QC determination: HOLD — Mesa Vista 4C is NOT marketing-ready.**

fields.Notes:
Internal punch list work underway. Tony has completed the kitchen faucet cartridge replacement, swapped the bathroom GFCI outlet, and patched the drywall. All three items marked done in this record; progress is being coordinated in #maintenance as each task wraps up. Deep clean and interior repaint still tracking on their respective schedules. Will update status to Ready once all vendor and in-house scopes are signed off.

Ran independent QC pass on the June turn (Move-Out 6/15, Target Ready 6/30 — now past due). Unit is NOT marketing-ready; status held at In Progress. Do NOT release for listing.
Two carrying scopes remain OPEN and fail the QC 'closed' standard (must be completed, signed off, AND vendor bill settled):
1) DEEP CLEAN — Sunshine Cleaning, QB bill 2026-SC-4C, $387 — not signed off; bill UNPAID (full $387 balance outstanding).
2) INTERIOR REPAINT — Permian Make-Ready Crew / Pete Donovan, QB bill PD-2026-09, $1,340 — not signed off; bill UNPAID (full $1,340 balance outstanding).
Re-inspection still pending (scheduled mid-July) — has not occurred as of 7/1, so QC gate is not cleared.
Note: prior 'market-ready' signals (report MR-4C-2026-08 and the separate Ready record with Move-Out 6/1 / Target 6/14) refer to an EARLIER 4C turn, not this June turn. Vendor bills for both current scopes are still unpaid in QuickBooks, contradicting any 'closed out' claim.
Opened OPS ticket detailing outstanding items; notified Carlos and Brooke. Will re-walk and sign off only once both scopes are complete, signed off, bills paid, and the re-inspection passes.

input.title: Mesa Vista 4C (June turn) — QC HOLD: not marketing-ready; deep clean + interior repaint open, vendor bills unpaid
input.description:
QC determination by Jaime Salinas (2026-07-01): Mesa Vista 4C is being held from listing. This covers the JUNE turn (Move-Out 2026-06-15, Target Ready 2026-06-30 — now past due), Airtable Make-Ready record recbd087a4abd605b, status In Progress.

Carlos flagged this turn as "wrapped" and asked Brooke to list it. My independent QC pass shows it is NOT closed. It does not go to listing until every outstanding scope is completed, signed off, and the vendor bill settled.

OUTSTANDING — must all clear before sign-off:

1) DEEP CLEAN — NOT CLOSED
   - Vendor: Sunshine Cleaning (Carmen Delgado)
   - QuickBooks bill 2026-SC-4C, $387.00
   - Status: not signed off in the make-ready record ("still tracking on schedule"); QB balance $387.00 OUTSTANDING (unpaid).
   - Action: confirm work complete + QC sign-off, then pay the vendor bill.

2) INTERIOR REPAINT — NOT CLOSED
   - Vendor: Permian Make-Ready Crew (Pete Donovan)
   - QuickBooks bill PD-2026-09, $1,340.00
   - Status: not signed off in the make-ready record; QB balance $1,340.00 OUTSTANDING (unpaid).
   - Action: confirm work complete + QC sign-off, then pay the vendor bill.

3) RE-INSPECTION — PENDING
   - A re-inspection is scheduled for mid-July and has not yet occurred (today is 7/1). The turn cannot be signed off until this pass is completed and clears.

Internal punch items (faucet cartridge, GFCI outlet, drywall patch) are done — those are not the blockers.

IMPORTANT — data hygiene: the "market-ready" signals for 4C (report MR-4C-2026-08 dated 2026-05-01, and the separate Ready make-ready record with Move-Out 6/1 / Target 6/14) describe an EARLIER 4C turn, not this June turn. Both current-scope vendor bills remain unpaid in QuickBooks, so "closed out" is not accurate for this turn.

DISPOSITION: HOLD — do not release Mesa Vista 4C for listing. Jaime will re-walk and sign off only once both scopes are complete, signed off, bills paid, and the re-inspection passes.

input.subject: Mesa Vista 4C — QC HOLD on the June turn (not marketing-ready)
input.body:
Carlos,

You have Mesa Vista 4C down as wrapped from its June turn and asked to release it to Brooke for listing. I ran my own QC pass before signing off, and I can't clear it. I'm holding 4C — it doesn't go to listing until every outstanding scope is closed and signed off. Here are the specifics.

This is the JUNE turn: Move-Out 6/15, Target Ready 6/30 (now past due). The make-ready record is still In Progress. The two scopes that carry this turn are the deep clean and the interior repaint, and neither is closed to my standard (complete + signed off + vendor bill settled):

1) Deep clean — Sunshine Cleaning (Carmen Delgado)
   - QuickBooks bill 2026-SC-4C, $387.00
   - Not signed off in the make-ready record, and the bill is UNPAID — full $387.00 still outstanding in QuickBooks.

2) Interior repaint — Permian Make-Ready Crew (Pete Donovan)
   - QuickBooks bill PD-2026-09, $1,340.00
   - Not signed off in the make-ready record, and the bill is UNPAID — full $1,340.00 still outstanding in QuickBooks.

On top of that, the re-inspection is scheduled for mid-July and hasn't happened yet, so the QC gate isn't cleared either.

One thing to flag so we're working off the same picture: the "market-ready" signals on 4C — the MR-4C-2026-08 completion report (dated 5/1) and the older make-ready record with a 6/1 move-out / 6/14 target — belong to an EARLIER 4C turn, not this June turn. QuickBooks still shows both of this turn's vendor bills unpaid, so "closed out" isn't accurate here.

To get 4C released, we need all of this to close:
   - Deep clean confirmed complete and signed off, then bill 2026-SC-4C paid.
   - Interior repaint confirmed complete and signed off, then bill PD-2026-09 paid.
   - Mid-July re-inspection completed and passing.

I've logged the full detail in OPS-1000 and posted the hold in #make-ready. I've also told Brooke directly not to market it yet. The moment both scopes are complete, signed off, the bills are paid, and the re-inspection passes, I'll re-walk it and sign it off.

Thanks,
Jaime Salinas
Quality Control Inspector, Star Property Management

content.text:
All actions are complete. Here's the picture and my call.

## Mesa Vista 4C — QC determination: **HOLD. Not marketing-ready. Do not list.**

### What I actually found (June turn: Move-Out 6/15, Target Ready 6/30 — past due)
The authoritative Make-Ready record for the June turn (`recbd087a4abd605b`) is still **In Progress**, with a note that "deep clean and interior repaint [are] still tracking on their respective schedules." Neither carrying scope is closed to your standard:

| Scope | Vendor | Work signed off? | Vendor bill | Paid? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Deep clean** | Sunshine Cleaning | ❌ No | QB 2026-SC-4C, $387 | ❌ **$387 outstanding** |
| **Interior repaint** | Permian Make-Ready Crew (Pete Donovan) | ❌ No | QB PD-2026-09, $1,340 | ❌ **$1,340 outstanding** |

Both fail on both counts — not signed off *and* the bill is sitting unpaid in QuickBooks. The internal punch items (faucet cartridge, GFCI, drywall patch) are done, but those aren't what carry the turn.

**Re-inspection:** scheduled for mid-July — it hasn't happened yet (today is 7/1), so the QC gate isn't cleared regardless.

### The trap Carlos fell into
The "market-ready" signals he's leaning on — the **MR-4C-2026-08 report (dated 5/1)**, the separate **"Ready" make-ready record (Move-Out 6/1 / Target 6/14)**, and his May Slack/owner emails ("deep clean is closed out," "fully wrapped up") — all belong to an **earlier 4C turn**, not this June one. QuickBooks still shows both of *this* turn's vendor bills unpaid, so "closed out" isn't true here.

### Actions taken
- **QC determination recorded** on the make-ready turn in Airtable (`recbd087a4abd605b`) — HOLD, status kept at In Progress, full rationale logged.
- **Ticket opened: [OPS-1000](https://linear.app/synthetic/issue/OPS-1000)** — spells out exactly what's left (deep clean sign-off + payment, repaint sign-off + payment, mid-July re-inspection).
- **Posted the hold in #make-ready**, tagging Carlos and Brooke.
- **Told Brooke directly** (DM) not to market 4C until it clears — she hears it from us first.
- **Email to Carlos drafted** (cc Brooke) with the specifics, ready in your drafts for you to review and send.

**The call:** 4C stays off the market. I'll re-walk and sign it off only once both scopes are complete, signed off, the two bills are paid, and the mid-July re-inspection passes.

One note: I could only see your own calendar (jaime.salinas@), which has no July events on it — I couldn't independently pull the mid-July re-inspection entry there. It's referenced as scheduled and is treated as a pending gate; worth confirming it's booked on the shared ops calendar.
